impact.text: the admin should process more way 'batches' in order to safely process the withdrawals otherwise he can run out of gas and revert the tx

precondition_sources.text: A user is able to queue as many withdrawals as he wants with any amount of shares he wants by calling queueWithdrawal.
A malicious user can submit withdrawal requests of a really small amount of shares (1 share).

intent_sources.text: Processing and canceling queued withdrawals must be structured so that looping over the queue does not grow unbounded with the number of queued requests.
